capture_scope.diff_semantics: Record additions/changes/removals are differences between unique snapshots observed by this tap, compared to the prior unique snapshot per observer. They are not counts of application operations or independently transmitted records.
capture_scope.ledger_snapshot_semantics: Each gossip_message contains a complete compressed EdgeVPN ledger block. Multiple buckets and records can coexist in one envelope.
capture_scope.phase_semantics: Phase labels are assigned from the latest phases.jsonl transition at the event timestamp. A phase label is separate from the semantic lifecycle category.
capture_scope.received_from_peer_id_semantics: Immediate relay peer observed by the tap; it is not necessarily the peer that originally published the ledger state.

limitations: One observer's local network vantage; relay IDs do not identify the original ledger publisher.
The lab disables DHT; no WAN behavior is measured. If mDNS capture is absent, discovery traffic may be outside this trace.
The run uses model-free peers. The gateway /v1/models probe is not model inference and no sharded inference workload is measured.
Observed removals are ledger state differences, not explicit leave messages. Peer disconnect, service loss, and eventual record expiry are reported as separate evidence.

A record or bucket removal means it was absent from a later snapshot received by this observer. That block may be from a stale, forked, or otherwise nonaccepted branch; block index and parent-hash lineage do not prove canonical acceptance. This trace cannot establish authoritative deletion, explicit departure, or prove that a leader-driven heartbeat-bucket scrub did or did not occur.
Repeated full snapshots can contain unchanged records. Counts of changed records are observed state differences, not record-level packet counts.

mdns_ttl_zero_observations.interpretation: DNS resource records with TTL 0 can signal DNS-level withdrawal/goodbye; they do not prove a LocalAI ledger leave or authoritative membership removal.

membership_and_resources.interpretation: Docker stats are sampled container measurements; listed API nodes and LastSeen-filtered fresh hosts are reported separately because cached/stale IDs can remain listed.

model_control_observations.interpretation: LocalAPI/model-control observations are separate from peer-to-peer ledger messages; a routed HTTP request is not counted as a gossip control message.

notes: Schedules below are configured intervals or expiry thresholds from source. EdgeVPN implements Announce and ledger synchronization with an exponential backoff ticker (5 second initial interval, randomized, configured maximum), so intervals are not exact packet timings.
The current harness profile disables DHT and leaves mDNS enabled; this states configuration intent, not proof that mDNS or any listed record was seen on the wire.
A record update creates a full new ledger block. Individual application records do not each map to distinct network packets.

ledger_gossip_envelope.interpretation: A packet capture may show GossipSub control/data frames and encrypted hub payloads. Do not count each bucket record as its own protocol message.
ledger_gossip_envelope.publish_triggers: Ledger Add/Delete writes a new block and immediately writes it to the hub queue; the periodic synchronizer also republishes the latest full block at its configured interval (10s maximum in LocalAI options).
source: EdgeVPN pkg/blockchain/ledger.go:Syncronizer, Announce, Update, Add, DeleteBucket, writeData (v0.34.0)
ledger_gossip_envelope.transport: EdgeVPN GossipSub room/topic; the topic is derived from the token and rotates with its configured OTP interval
wire_layers: Application record(s) are stored in a complete ledger Storage map.
The complete Block JSON has fields Index, Timestamp, Storage, Hash, PrevHash; EdgeVPN gzip-compresses it.
The compressed bytes are sealed by EdgeVPN's configured sealer before being written to the hub.
EdgeVPN publishes a JSON hub.Message with fields Message, SenderID, Annotations. SenderID is set from GossipSub's ReceivedFrom on receipt; Annotations is optional.
